notes.title: Items– silent helpers of your quest!
notes.content: [p]A procedural, ever-changing game comes with its own set of challenges. As we are unable to study and practice levels, there should be a new angle to help us sort the challenges. And so we had one thing clear in the development process: climbers would need something to aid their quest![/p][p]Perhaps it was more accurate to think of someTHINGS rather than just one: and so we brought \[b]ITEMS\[/b] into the scene. Of course, we’d need a great variety of them; in matters of taste, there are no fixed rules![/p][p]Eldritch Climb is a quirky game with mechanics of its own, a catalogue of enemies that remix the worst and iconic horrors of classic literature, and for the items we thought of two ways to interact with them: \[b]hand items\[/b] and \[b]passive items\[/b].[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/1864b7eb30218c2a563f462d82a6ef409d5631f5.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/1864b7eb30218c2a563f462d82a6ef409d5631f5.gif"][/img][/url][/p][h3][b]Hand Items[/b][/h3][p]What is that default item 99% of the climbers have installed since day one? HANDS. And yes, we certainly loved that plural right there! Because the only thing better than a hand, is having two hands. So, with that thought in mind, it became obvious to us that we should allow the climbers to \[i]possess two items simultaneously\[/i].[/p][p]This opened up the possibility to a mix-match couple of items for the players to explore. And we began to brainstorm the possibilities! Either items with an offensive or defensive, perhaps something to assist in the climb or even prevent a certain type of damage appeared. The idea behind this varied catalogue? To let the players decide \[i]which combo suits them best\[/i]![/p][h3]Passive Items[/h3][p]You probably have a friendship bracelet from a concert you went a while ago. Or perhaps you keep that trading card that brought you luck back in the day. This idea of possessing something to be there passively to help you sort the day-to-day conflicts felt like a necessity in a mountain full of horrid creatures.[/p][p]The idea behind this type of item is to provide the player with an \[i]extra leverage on their quest\[/i]. Either to help them navigate better, to offer a bit of an advantage against enemies and environmental damage… and more.[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/e63aa12ee02ab5d5282244ab9d39a0944dcc9c3c.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/e63aa12ee02ab5d5282244ab9d39a0944dcc9c3c.gif"][/img][/url][/p][h3][b]Chests? Corpses? They both begin with a “C”![/b][/h3][p]As we needed a way to make these items accessible to the users, we thought that environmental storytelling corpses would be the best way to do so. After all, why not pay a bit of homage to those climbers who had a worse fate than you?[/p][p]And maybe \[i]MAYBE\[i] there might be other ways to come across items to find your way into the mysteries of the mountain. I dunno! I guess you’ll have to play Eldritch Climb to figure this one out![/p][p]Hit that [b]WISHLIST[/b] button and step into Nathan Danforth’s shoes (literally) to answer the Mountain’s Call![/p][p]We’d love to hear from you. Follow us on our social media:[/p][list][*][p][b]Instagram:[/b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/covertwonders/"]https://www.instagram.com/covertwonders/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]TikTok:[/b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@covertwonders"]https://www.tiktok.com/@covertwonders[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]X:[/b] [url="https://x.com/CovertWonders"]https://x.com/CovertWonders[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Roots of Horror: What Inspired The Climb
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/d370f88fb4f009cb2be436de01fc68f710bc2480.jpg[/img]
If you've played our game, you’ll have noticed its quirky mechanics: players escalate by grabbing nodes, spinning aimlessly, and darting in the direction they release. While that’s a humorous way to progress—up a mountain (or hopelessly down)—it also created the perfect mountaineering scenario for a cosmic horror story: [b]a perilous mountain looming with danger[/b].

[h2]H.P. Lovecraft: The Patron of Cosmic Horror[/h2]

When discussing this genre—focused on the mysterious, the unfathomable to the human mind, and the infinite possibilities of the universe—Lovecraft inevitably comes to mind. We drew inspiration from his work when crafting our story’s setting: why not depict the downfall into madness of a once-respected mathematician and college professor?

Lovecraft’s stories often explore the boundary between human knowledge and the unknown—those things we *don't* understand. For him, the greatest fear lies in the stuff beyond our human understanding, regardless of how much we already know. There’s always something bigger. Something [i]BEYOND[/i] our comprehension… 

Our guiding star? [i]The Mountains of Madness[/i] .We wanted to tell a tale where the main character explores a mythological place and confronts its hidden horrors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/358d9085a7c34cbd4a680c9fdf7032fe3ad8f5cd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Junji Ito: The Master of the Unsettling[/h2]

Today, Junji Ito is an institution in horror, despite his adorable persona and love for wearing cat paws and ears. He specializes in crafting disturbingly ordinary yet deeply unsettling settings—magnifying humanity’s self-destructive traits and turning protagonists into their own worst enemies.

Because, really, there's no worse evil than our own mind, right? Inspired by Ito’s [i]The Amigara Fault[/i], one of our game’s core features revolves around mental alteration—collecting ‘Eyes’ shifts your perception of reality, revealing a dreadful mountain—and emphasizes the inescapability of deadly destiny.

Coincidence that Ito’s story is also set near a mountain? Definitely not!

[h2]Eldritch Climb: Where Cosmic Horror Meets the Comic[/h2]

Drawing from these two masters, we created a game that messes with your mind [b]cosmically and comically[/b]! You’ll uncover the terrifying secrets of the Mountain, encounter its cult and creatures, and—over and over—spin, die, and spin again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/5f565ea01a863520af31ee2627e97462b58a39fc.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Eyes: an insightful offering!
notes.content:
Hello, Mountaineers of Eldritch Horrors! In this second entry, we’ll know more about the coined currency you earn the more you interact with the mountain: the Eyes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/841191462c26ff10fe79161d21196d5c9a4cf82b.jpg[/img]

Either to learn more about the mountain and its character’s secrets, or to offer it to an unknown deity in order to face the horror with less challenge, the EYES will be the way.  

[h1]DIFFICULTY AND REVELATIONS[/h1]

Making your way to the mountain top, you’ll notice greenish bubbles floating around the levels, which also appear by defeating enemies or looting corpses.  

As an explorer of the horrid unknown, as you interact with your surroundings, the more you’ll get to *see* the ever-growing horrors of the Mountain. The more you’ve seen… it is EYES you gain! 

The Mountain will react to your level of Eyes,  as you accumulate the little green eye-bubbles, the more it’ll begin to reveal its truest twisted nature: enemies will be more hostile, the levels will turn and twist into a horrid nightmare. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/b173ef07a332d57b13431375ee365f9eefd94f53.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/b173ef07a332d57b13431375ee365f9eefd94f53.gif[/img][/url]

Something that is revealed before your eyes and once unseen it can’t be unseen… Or can’t it?

[h1]THE STATUE OF OFFERINGS[/h1]

Little is known about this statue when you arrive. But is it ominously there. The Hooded One, a mysterious man of a somber demeanor, hints at the usage of said statue at the beginning of the game: it is a place of offerings. 

And what little you have to offer but the knowledge you have gathered?

Its intricate design reveals and darkens the symbolism it holds. On one hand, it points to a culture whose twisted perception built a convoluted effigy, to which offer the Eyes, in the hopes of navigating the Mountain in a less hostile environment. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/5f565ea01a863520af31ee2627e97462b58a39fc.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/5f565ea01a863520af31ee2627e97462b58a39fc.gif[/img][/url]

But on the other hand, what do the symbols around it stand for? And who precisely is receiving all those offerings. And even more unsettling, with what end does this unknown entity engulf the precious Eyes?

Get ready to unveil the mysteries surrounding the Eyes (quite literally) and answer the Mountain’s Call when we release the game later this year!

notes.title: Meet Professor Danforth!
notes.content:
[h2]A PROFESSOR GONE MAD?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/f836ea1cd872a55375129d8510900710f6e4314b.png[/img]

Nathan Danforth is the heir to the renowned Danforth family, having contributed to its legacy through his own merits. He is an emeritus member of the Mathematics and Natural Philosophy Royal Academy within Grey University, an expert in patterns, and a lover of puzzles.

Over the years, his studies led him down the path of researching the greatest patterns known to humankind, scattered throughout the cosmos. He specialized in the fields of cryptology and cosmology, publishing a thesis titled *The Pattern of the Cosmos: A Mathematical Approach to the Sky.* But that’s when the once-honorable academic began to lose his grip on reality—especially after discovering a rather intriguing tome that held secrets and codes only he could decipher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/3e6ecb85b18d8f2d7707193e02babf99ffef61ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]ADVENTURER OF THE UNKNOWN?[/h2]

Convinced that he was on the verge of solving the greatest puzzle of all time, Professor Danforth’s lectures became increasingly filled with esoteric theories. He sought knowledge from other departments, ones devoted to fiction and the impossible realms of myth. He claimed to have found a Mountain that could grant powers so immense they could even defy death. Some even heard him say it was as if the Mountain was calling to him…

Furthermore, he swore he had uncovered the Mountain’s coordinates—leading to a place only speculated upon by dubious adventurers. But his academic reputation grew weaker and weaker as his claims became more outlandish. Still, being the heir to a wealthy family has its advantages, doesn’t it?

Danforth gathered a small group of believers, promising them that he would return with proof—proof that would silence the institutions and professors who mocked him.

And so, he ventured forth alone, pouring the riches of the Danforth family into funding his impossible journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912645/841191462c26ff10fe79161d21196d5c9a4cf82b.jpg[/img]

Hit that **WISHLIST** button if you’re ready to step into Nathan Danforth’s shoes (quite literally) and answer the Mountain’s Call!
